article.story: LYNCHBURG, Va. -- — Eli Sancomb scored 20 points as Liberty beat North Carolina Central 74-66 on Friday. Sancomb also had 10 rebounds for the Flames (2-1). Zander Carter scored 13 points, going 5 of 12 and 3 of 5 from the free-throw line. Cooper Campbell shot 4 for 10, including 3 for 5 from beyond the arc to finish with 12 points. Cristian Sanon led the Eagles (0-4) in scoring, finishing with 14 points. NC Central also got 13 points, nine rebounds and two blocks from Tyler Mason. Ryan Archey also had 12 points. Liberty took the lead with 8:36 left in the first half and did not trail again. Sancomb led their team in scoring with 11 points in the first half to help put them ahead 40-34 at the break. Liberty turned a five-point second-half lead into a 12-point advantage with a 7-0 run to make it a 56-44 lead with 10:59 left in the half. Sancomb scored nine second-half points in the matchup. Up next NC Central: hosts Virginia-Lynchburg on Monday. Liberty: hosts Southern Illinois on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
